reviewer.role: Independent final changed-result/admission reviewer; same reviewer as completed R6, distinct from all three scientific authors and root envelope/renderer author.
reviewer.method: Read changed saved results/assessments/claims, count and compare saved JSON records, reconcile metadata, hash actual bytes, and inspect existing PNGs. No scientific computation, C5 source reread, broad census/literature replay, or future-document review.

evidence_binding.aggregate_identity_definition: SHA256 of UTF8 compact sorted-key JSON file-row list followed by one LF
evidence_binding.excluded_dynamic_surfaces: Manifest itself, DAG/admission/workflow/execution ledger, final report/handoff/delivery and C9 review; these are separate evidence records, not circular payload members.
evidence_binding.note: Hashing unchanged source bytes establishes identity reuse; it does not constitute a second source-code review.

admission.scope: Original supplied nonnegative B3 coefficient cone; exact rational nonaligned clocks; original-t0 memory and positive B4 convolution; conditional full-A/source/whole-forcing/clock premises for all permitted starts and admissible histories; exact certificates plus explicitly separate fixed-guard Decimal evidence.
admission.lower_bound_meaning: Lower enclosure of ideal comparison functions, not physical error.
admission.q0_meaning: Arithmetic kernel/control boundary; no claim that a synthetic q=0 fixture certifies a finite-time zero-contraction physical Markov family.
admission.future_stage_boundary: Root may carry out already authorized S09 adoption/publication and S10 closeout. This review binds the current candidate and payload; it does not claim those future actions have occurred or require another recursive prepublication scientific review.

checks.subject: Independent static basis and frozen identities
checks.observation: Completed independent R6 verdict PASS_SCOPED_STATIC_R6 (24/24, zero open material findings) remains byte-identical. All 30 frozen proof, design, input, computational, target and static-review files match current bytes. C5 sources were not reread or executed.

checks.subject: Actual scientific payload identity
checks.observation: All 70 unique payload paths match recorded byte sizes, SHA-256 digests and Git blob identities. Compact sorted-key file-row JSON with one LF hashes to the declared 828888e952c15bd94d37d7dd30c0676df9470ca316bb1dbb8334c6c218b0e909. Frozen 30 are an exact subset. Dynamic review/admission surfaces are explicitly excluded to avoid self-reference.

checks.subject: Primary actual process and finite envelope
checks.observation: One recorded attempt exited 0 without timeout, producing the actual 1240432-byte primary result identity. OS CPU 0.568891 s, wall 0.5699985149985878 s and maximum RSS 18560 KiB are within the recorded 120 s / 180 s / 1 GiB limits; stderr is empty. The source commit and 30-file freeze binding are recorded.

checks.subject: Primary saved check coverage
checks.observation: 302 distinct primary check records are PASS: 21 model executions, 68 rejection guards, 126 exact certificates, 54 mathematical controls, 24 finite-work controls, two depth-sweep records, two analytic interval crosschecks, two parser boundaries and three source identities. The 21 models contain 75 base cells and are all ARITHMETIC_CONTROL_PREMISE. All 68 guards report the expected DomainError class with nonempty messages. The two depth records contain 14 actual saved rows.

checks.subject: Primary identity and certificate scope
checks.observation: Saved before/after identity checks bind the same 30-file manifest and arithmetic source. Synthetic controls, including q=0, retain arithmetic-premise classification; they are not promoted to physical full-A family certification.

checks.subject: Reference actual process and saved input binding
checks.observation: One recorded reference attempt exited 0 without timeout and consumed the exact actual primary SHA-256. OS CPU 2.0602710000000000003 s, wall 2.0909859919993323 s and RSS 20268 KiB are within 180 s / 240 s / 1 GiB. Its 197286-byte output and seven-file input-stability check match recorded identities.

checks.subject: Reference record taxonomy
checks.observation: 302 distinct (case_id,id) reference records and 21 case statuses are PASS. Categories remain separate: 238 pure exact records (including exact diagnostic/integer/metadata categories), 21 mixed exact-structure/guarded-Decimal records, 42 guarded-Decimal records and one metadata-only record. There are no campaign errors. Exact metadata records are not misrepresented here as additional numerical identities.

checks.subject: Fixed Decimal guard and strict-miss retention
checks.observation: The saved comparison policy remains precision 160, phi terms 512 and fixed absolute guard 1e-80. All 784 guarded comparisons pass. All 59 strict misses remain counted, including the full per-case count map, with the declared first 50 examples preserved and within_guard=true. The zero-z W1 singleton [1/5,1/5] example retains the slightly smaller Decimal approximation. Neither strict success nor exact outward-rounding certification is claimed for Decimal.

checks.subject: Independent root diagnostics and arithmetic caps
checks.observation: All seven root-pattern diagnostic records and all 14 reference depth rows are retained, with no unresolved root clusters. Internal exact Sturm cap 1048576 bits remains distinct from the 16384-bit derived/saved cap. Recorded observed internal numerator/denominator maxima 1313/1302 and derived maxima 1291/1291 are below their respective caps. These are observations of saved execution records, not a rerun.

checks.subject: Saved work and gap summary consistency
checks.observation: Saved totals are 677 splits and 1429 visits over 75 base cells, with maximum 191 splits / 383 visits in one cell. D=96 rational-critical diagnostic has exact gap zero and work 3/7. Algebraic-critical diagnostic retains a positive exact rational gap displayed as 3.8938557722194933e-60 and work 191/383. The corresponding displayed proved bounds are 1.7091986279788588e-30 and 2.4980595331998706e-30. The 288/577 depth-96 work ceiling is consistent with the frozen proof; these saved examples do not establish a universal CPU guarantee.

checks.subject: CAS submitted source binding
checks.observation: Actual submitted source is 8361 bytes and SHA-256 e423af7b6eadbe37a2205e516e29857ae9bce5e69fc1610d426acbc56af541be, identical to the frozen CAS source. The existing final byte is LF; extra_LF=0 is retained. No CAS was executed during C9.

checks.subject: Observed raw CAS response
checks.observation: The one saved text response is not an error, states ALL_RESIDUALS_ZERO and contains 72 unique residual IDs, all with literal exact value 0. The ID set exactly equals the 72 frozen target IDs. No message/warning marker or separate warning content block is observed. This supports scoped symbolic corroboration; no diagnosis of previous warnings or unobserved CAS CPU/wall time is inferred.

checks.subject: Renderer actual process and output provenance
checks.observation: One renderer attempt exited 0 without timeout, with CPU 3.2705849999999999803 s, wall 3.2812038280026172 s and RSS 89364 KiB within 15 s / 45 s / 1 GiB. Inputs bind the actual primary/reference outputs and unchanged renderer. Two PNGs, two SVGs and PLOT_DATA identities match actual bytes. No scientific run, ODE or production import was added by rendering.

checks.subject: Saved plot data integrity
checks.observation: Q0_INITIAL_JUMP and NONALIGNED_NEGATIVE_D plot model-data objects are structurally identical to their saved primary result objects. Both saved depth-sweep objects are also structurally identical. Plot file identities and input bindings match the payload.

checks.subject: Actual reviewer inspection of saved figures
checks.observation: This reviewer viewed both existing PNGs. Labels are readable; whole-cell certificates are horizontal and distinguished from dashed endpoint connectors; kernel left limits and actual endpoints are visibly different; the q=0 endpoint is 1/4 versus left limit 5/4; nonaligned signed-d panels retain their separate clocks. The convergence image distinguishes zero-gap markers from positive gaps and displays the D=96 work bound. Captions state comparison-function scope and that saved figures do not rerun science.

checks.subject: Current claim and physical scope
checks.observation: Claims remain in the supplied original nonnegative Bernstein-B3 coefficient cone and source-bound full-A contraction/whole-forcing/clock premises for every permitted start and admissible history. Lower enclosures concern ideal comparison functions, not physical error lower bounds. q=0 fixtures remain arithmetic controls. Actual HD, named physical consumer/state/density-clock evidence remains pending; HH_R10 OFF, production NOT_ISSUED, L4 false and physical/central completion deltas zero are preserved. No new strong no-go claim or universal maximal-domain CPU guarantee is introduced.

checks.subject: Inherited DAG structural preservation
checks.observation: All 44 inherited node objects match the R14 input exactly under structural JSON comparison by ID. Current DAG has 46 nodes, recorded 29 complete, and exactly the two requested new R15 node IDs; both are currently OPEN. No inherited node or prior scientific claim is re-adjudicated by C9.

checks.subject: Two-node conditional admission candidate
checks.observation: The candidate binds the verified 70-file scientific payload and asks only for WU_HD_CUBIC_BERNSTEIN_FORCING_THEORY_R15 and WU_HD_CUBIC_BERNSTEIN_FORCING_CODE_R15. Their dependency/scope metadata is compatible with the existing R14 conditional nodes. The evidence supports root adoption as two scoped conditional completions, changing 29/46 to 31/46 with zero physical or central completion delta. This review does not itself mutate the DAG or attest to future S09/S10 documents.

checks.subject: Execution ledger reconciliation
checks.observation: All three local finished ledger events equal their process records apart from the added FINISHED status; the CAS finished event retains the matching actual attempt identity and assessment. Actual counts are one primary, one reference, one CAS, one renderer, zero ODE and no repair attempt. Measured local scientific CPU is 2.6291620000000000003 s; render CPU is separately recorded. CAS CPU and global historical remaining allowance stay null; old allowance increase is zero.

checks.subject: Temporal status and results-document consistency
checks.observation: Earlier immutable start/stage records are retained as historical snapshots: initial CAS attempt STARTED, primary-stage reference/CAS NOT_RUN_YET, and renderer PENDING_ACTUAL_VISUAL_REVIEW. Later finished ledger, assessments and actual visual review supply the completed states. Current results prose uses the completed evidence while retaining all raw records and strict misses; no prospective scientific PASS substitutes for an actual result.

limitations: Conditional theorem and implementation evidence does not admit a physical HD consumer; actual source/state/density-clock evidence remains pending.
Guarded Decimal comparisons remain distinct from exact/rational enclosure proofs. The 59 strict misses are retained and not reclassified as strict successes.
The 21-model/75-cell campaign and 14 depth rows verify the bounded saved controls; they do not establish universal maximal-domain CPU/memory performance.
CAS corroborates the stated 72 frozen symbolic targets. Its CPU and actual remote wall time are not supplied by the raw response and remain null.
S09 adoption/publication, backup restore and S10 handoff are subsequent root actions outside this completed changed-result review.
